extraction_warnings: PDF source uses 8-digit codes without dots (e.g., '36010010') and 6-digit subheading codes without dots (e.g., '360100'). Normalized to NNNN.NN.NN format (e.g., '3601.00.10') and NNNN.NN format (e.g., '3601.00') per project schema.

PDF table-chrome headers ('Main Notes', 'Sl.No. Notes Notification No Notification Date', 'Product Description and Export Policy', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition') were recognized as table chrome and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.
Section VI 'Main Notes' (4 notes) on PDF page 1 are attributed to section_notes (Section VI, Products of the Chemical or Allied Industries), not chapter_notes.

On the Section VI Main Notes table (page 1), the column order is 'SI.No. | Notes | Notification No | Notification Date'. On the Chapter 36 Main Notes table (page 2), the column order is reversed to 'SI.No. | Notes | Notification Date | Notification No'. Both note tables in this chapter have empty Notification No / Notification Date columns — no notifications are cited in the source PDF for any note or for any tariff line.

Source PDF describes 'articles of combustible materials' in heading 3606 Note 2 with doubled quotation marks: ''articles of combustible materials''. Preserved verbatim — the intended text uses single pairs of typographic double quotes.
Heading 3603 description is rendered in ALL CAPS in the source PDF: 'SAFETY FUSES; DETONATING CORDS; PERCUSSION OR DETONATING CAPS; IGNITERS; ELECTRIC DETONATORS'. Preserved verbatim.

Subheading codes 3601.00, 3602.00, 3605.00 appear in the PDF as 6-digit codes (360100, 360200, 360500) with descriptions that essentially repeat the parent heading title (sometimes with a trailing colon, e.g., 'Propellant powders :'). Preserved verbatim and represented as standard NNNN.NN subheading rows containing the relevant tariff lines.

Heading 3604 has subheading 3604.10 (Fireworks) presented as an 8-digit tariff line '36041000' in the PDF (no separate 6-digit '360410' row shown). For schema consistency it is represented as subheading 3604.10 with a single tariff line 3604.10.00 'Fireworks'.

Heading 3605 has subheading 3605.00 ('Matches, other than pyrotechnic articles of heading 3604 :') with tariff lines 3605.00.10 (Safety matches) and 3605.00.90 (Other). Some HS nomenclatures use '3605.00' as a single subheading rather than separate 3605.10/3605.90 — the PDF source structure is preserved.

Heading 3606 has subheading 3606.10 (Liquid or liquefied-gas fuels...) presented as an 8-digit tariff line '36061000' in the PDF. Represented as subheading 3606.10 with a single tariff line 3606.10.00.

Tariff lines 3606.90.91, 3606.90.92, 3606.90.93, 3606.90.99 carry descriptions prefixed 'Other: ---- ' in the source PDF (e.g., 'Other: ---- Ferro-cerium, in all forms'). The '---- ' is a sub-classification indicator from the WCO HS nomenclature. Preserved verbatim.

Export Policy column for every tariff line in this chapter is 'Free'. The Policy Condition column is EMPTY for every tariff line — no Chapter 36 Policy Conditions are listed in the source PDF. SCOMET/munitions controls on explosives are administered through India's SCOMET regime (Schedule 2 Appendix 3) and may apply outside this Schedule 2 tariff schedule listing; however, no SCOMET notification number, no policy condition, and no notification date is captured in the Chapter 36 PDF source — none invented.

Source PDF contains no 'Policy Condition' table, no 'Sub-Heading Notes' table, no 'Export Licensing Notes' table for Chapter 36. policy_conditions array therefore left empty (no notifications captured) — this reflects the source PDF and is not an extraction omission.

chapter_notes.text: This Chapter does not cover separate chemically defined compounds other than those described in Note 2(a) or 2(b) below.

The expression ""articles of combustible materials"" in heading 3606 applies only to: (a) metaldehyde, hexamethylenetetramine and similar substances, put up in forms (for example, tablets, sticks or similar forms) for use as fuels; fuels with a basis of alcohol, and similar prepared fuels, in solid or semi-solid form; (b) liquid or liquefied-gas fuels in containers of a kind used for filling or refilling cigarette or similar lighters and of a capacity not exceeding 300 cm3 ; and (c) resin torches, firelighters and the like.

section_notes.text: (A) Goods (other than radioactive ores) answering to a description in heading 2844 or 2845 are to be classified in those headings and in no other heading of this Schedule. (B) Subject to paragraph (A) above, goods answering to a description in heading 2843, 2846 or 2852 are to be classified in those headings and in no other heading of this Section.

Subject to Note 1 above, goods classifiable in heading 3004, 3005, 3006, 3212, 3303, 3304, 3305, 3306, 3307, 3506, 3707 or 3808 by reason of being put up in measured doses or for retail sale are to be classified in those headings and in no other heading of this Schedule.

Goods put up in sets consisting of two or more separate constituents,some or all of which fall in this Section and are intended to be mixed together to obtain a product of Section VI or VII, are to be classified in the heading appropriate to that product, provided that the constituents are: (a) having regard to the manner in which they are put up, clearly identifiable as being intended to be used together without first being repacked; (b) presented together; and (c) identifiable, whether by their nature or by the relative proportions in which they are present, as being complementary one to another.

Where a product answers to a description in one or more of the headings in Section VI by virtue of being described by name or function and also to heading 3827, then it is classifiable in a heading that references the product by name or function and not under heading 3827.
